revisions.name: $th_sse_rm
revisions.reason: MINSS/MAXSS add synchronous m32 reads through existing gl32 and a per-thread XMM low-lane write before ordinary dispatch. The scalar branch does not set EIP, raise SEH, invoke guest callbacks, retain pointers, or introduce invocation state. Existing alignment-fault EIP write and return paths remain unchanged. Full production native and trampoline regressions preserve source/destination upper lanes and EFLAGS, including sparse unaligned and m32 page-end guards. MXCSR status and configurable DAZ/FTZ remain unsupported; general invocation ownership stays pending.
